i.norm: Verifies that processBitMapPairs returns false when the paired predicate rejects a comparison. The filter has a non-empty internal bit map (allocated by the shape), but the BitMapExtractor supplied to processBitMapPairs wraps an empty array. After the extractor is exhausted, CountingLongPredicate.processRemaining() iterates the filter's own longs and invokes the LongBiPredicate for each one. Because the mock is configured to always return false, the very first invocation short-circuits and the overall call returns false.
A large shape so the filter's internal bit map contains multiple longs
An empty extractor contributes no bit-map longs to the pair walk
Predicate that always rejects — causes processBitMapPairs to return false
